title: ICAI Releases Comprehensive Year-End Transfer Pricing Compliance Handbook for FY 2025-26
content:
# ICAI Releases Comprehensive Year-End Transfer Pricing Compliance Handbook for FY 2025-26

Ek important update hai! The Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI) ke International Taxation Committee ne ek naya aur bahut useful resource release kiya hai. Yeh hai "Handbook on Year-End Transfer Pricing Compliance Checklists" for Financial Year 2025-26 (Assessment Year 2026-27).

This handbook serves as a structured aur practical guide, specially designed for professionals and taxpayers to navigate the complex year-end Transfer Pricing (TP) compliances. It aims to complement the existing statutory framework by offering clear guidance, compliance checklists, documentation requirements, aur useful templates. The handbook has been prepared keeping in mind the Income-tax Act, 1961, as amended by the Finance Act, 2026.

Here are some key highlights from the Handbook:

*   **Scope:** It covers critical aspects like the Accountant's Report in Form No. 3CEB, contemporaneous Transfer Pricing documentation, Master File (Form No. 3CEAA), and Country-by-Country Reporting (CbCR) (Form No. 3CEAD).
*   **Form 3CEB:** For FY 2025-26, the due date for furnishing Form No. 3CEB is specified as October 31, 2026, for taxpayers engaged in international transactions or Specified Domestic Transactions (SDTs) where the aggregate value exceeds ₹20 crore. Non-compliance can lead to a penalty of ₹1,00,000 under Section 271BA.
*   **TP Documentation:** The Handbook emphasizes the requirement under Section 92D read with Rule 10D for maintaining prescribed TP documentation. This applies when the aggregate value of international transactions exceeds ₹1 crore, or SDTs exceed ₹20 crore, during the financial year. This documentation must be in place by the due date for furnishing Form No. 3CEB or the return of income. Failure to maintain this can attract a penalty of 2% of the value of each relevant transaction under Section 271AA(1).
*   **Master File (Form 3CEAA):** The due date for filing Form No. 3CEAA (Part A) for constituent entities of an international group is November 30, 2026. A penalty of ₹5 lakh may be levied under Section 271AA(2) for non-compliance.
*   **CbCR (Form 3CEAD):** For Country-by-Country Reporting, the Handbook illustrates a filing date of March 31, 2027, for an accounting year ending March 31, 2026.

This handbook will be a valuable tool for ensuring timely and accurate year-end TP compliance.
